brief:
Displaced families across Gaza face mounting food insecurity as planned reductions in humanitarian assistance coincide with ongoing restrictions on aid deliveries into the territory, Al Jazeera English reported. The combination threatens to exacerbate an already severe hunger crisis affecting the population.

Aid organizations have warned that the simultaneous pressures—reduced funding commitments and logistical barriers to moving supplies across borders—leave vulnerable populations at acute risk. Families relying on humanitarian support say conditions are deteriorating rapidly.
dek: Displaced families in Gaza fear worsening food insecurity as planned aid cuts coincide with continued restrictions.
title: Aid cuts and shipment curbs deepen Gaza famine fears
